name: bottom-nav
title: Bottom Nav
description: Bottom navigation in five looks — minimal dot, floating capsule, expanding pill, notched centre FAB and top indicator with a spotlight. A liquid indicator stretches between tabs (leading edge first, trailing edge catching up), icons morph from outline to filled with a spring and a lift, active labels rise in, badges pop, the solid accent action button glows softly, and every change ticks a haptic.
props: Tabs. `icon` is a built-in name (home, explore, search, projects, saved, profile, inbox, activity, analytics, message, work, browse, library, music, create) or a render function `({ color, size, active }) => node` — called for both the outline (`active: false`) and filled (`active: true`) states so it can morph.
Called when a tab is pressed.
Called when an `action: true` item (e.g. Create) is pressed. Action items render as a solid accent button and never become active.
Active colour and the action button fill.
Opt-in two-colour gradient for the action button.
Show labels. `floating` and `pill` reveal only the active label; the others show all.
Extra bottom padding — pass `useSafeAreaInsets().bottom` when the bar sits at the screen edge.
Selection tick on tab change, light impact on the action button.
Style of the bar (the outer shadow view for `floating`).
